final_span: times when it can feel like a stretch to find Caveney’s purpose in going into such painful detail about his early abuse. Nevertheless, once the hidden essence of his father’s abuse was uncovered, these hurtful stories started to become clearer. In the past, this abuse has served as the headline of Caveney’s stories online and in print, and over time, he’s come to tribes with his pain on debut documentaries for the BBC’s Radio Days project, which are presented on the companion audio-CD to “Gibberish.” Yet as he approaches two key milestones by turning 50 and 60, he has distanced himself from the public displays of abuse and begun to examine the circumstances surrounding them.
